provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

name.text: Everything There of an Inquisitor and Proceeding Inquisitor (Canto III)

shortName.text: Everything There of an Inquisitor and allies

lead.text: Deal attack damage to every enemy to reduce Instincts, lowering Power and Protection. However, a strong first hit against the imitation Counter lets it return that skill's Power. Hit enemies readying the Counter first with a fast Sinner's weak skill, and keep them out of multi-target E.G.O attacks.

listLead.text: Hit every enemy to remove buffs. Check order and area coverage so a powerful skill does not hit the imitating Counter first.

statNote.text: A 4-enemy battle in the Sacristy on Floor 2 of the Canto III dungeon. There are 2 Lv. 26 Everything There of an Inquisitor units (302 main-body HP, 211 Part HP, Defense Level 30) and 2 Proceeding Inquisitors (242 main-body HP, 170 Part HP, Defense Level 28). These differ from the Floor 1 Lv. 24 and Floor 3 Lv. 29 versions and fixed-slot Refraction Railway versions.

skillNote.text: The 4 shared skills are listed by user, giving 8 entries. Imperfect Imitation's Power, Coin Power, and Coin count depend on the attack it receives, so fixed values are not shown. It copies those numbers but retains Lust, Slash, and the enemy's own level; it does not copy On Hit or On Use effects.

priorities.0.text: Deal attack damage to every enemy from the opening to lower Instincts. Each instance of at least 1 attack damage reduces Instincts by 1, lowering Power and Protection.

priorities.1.text: Imperfect Imitation is an ordinary Counter and cannot be Offset. Make a fast Sinner's weak skill the first hit, and check that multi-target E.G.O does not also hit that enemy.

priorities.2.text: An enemy that takes no attack damage heals 5% HP and gains 1 Instincts at Turn End. Avoid leaving enemies untouched, but do not force a strong hit into a Counter when no safe weak skill is available.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: A strong E.G.O attack got my Sinner killed by the Counter

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: The imitation Counter copies the Power, Coin Power, and Coin count of the first attack received. It also activates if hit as an additional target of a multi-target attack. Land a fast Sinner's weak skill first, or exclude that enemy from the multi-target attack.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: The enemy healed and grew stronger despite having Burn

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Reducing Instincts and preventing healing requires at least 1 attack damage. Status damage alone does not satisfy the condition.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Weak hits are not reducing Instincts

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: If Protection or resistances reduce attack damage to 0, Damaged Arms does not activate. Choose a skill that can deal at least 1 damage. Against a Counter, also avoid using excessive Power.

units.0.notes.0.text: 2 enemies. Start with 4 Instincts and gain Attack Power Up and Protection equal to Instincts.

units.0.notes.1.text: Normally has 2 actions. Skills change with Instincts. Continues acting and remains targetable after Part destruction.

units.1.notes.0.text: 2 enemies. Start with 2 Instincts; has 1 action below 4 Instincts and 2 actions at 4 or more.

units.1.notes.1.text: Continues acting and remains targetable after Part destruction. Keep its starting Instincts and Defense Level distinct from the other type.

phases.0.title.text: Check Counters and lower Instincts across the enemy team

phases.0.steps.0.text: The 2 Everything There of an Inquisitor units start with 4 Instincts; the 2 Proceeding Inquisitors start with 2. More Instincts means more Attack Power Up and Protection.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Deal at least 1 attack damage to each enemy to reduce Instincts. With ×0.5 Slash and ×0.75 Pierce resistance, Blunt is the better physical option. Wrath and Envy are also effective.

phases.0.steps.2.text: First identify enemies readying Counters. Before hitting everyone with a multi-target attack, check actual targets to avoid triggering a high-Power imitation Counter.

phases.1.steps.0.text: Among Sinners attacking that enemy, give the fastest one a weak skill. Its Power, Coin Power, and Coin count are copied, so do not make a strong many-Coin skill or E.G.O the first hit.

phases.1.steps.1.text: The Counter keeps the enemy's Sin affinity, attack type, and level. Even if your attack is Blunt or another affinity, the response remains Lust and Slash. Also account for its 10 SP damage On Use.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Ordinary Counters cannot be Offset with defense. If no safe weak skill is available, avoid a reckless attack even if that allows HP healing and Instincts gain. Staggering it with the first attack can prevent the Counter, but Protection and resistances make this reliable only when the attack can certainly reach the Threshold.

phases.2.title.text: Stop no-hit healing and Adjust Shell

phases.2.steps.0.text: Enemies that took no attack damage heal 5% HP and gain 1 Instincts at Turn End. In particular, leaving an enemy at 3 Instincts untouched lets it return to 4 and become aggressive.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Adjust Shell heals 10% max HP and grants 1 Instincts on hit. Win the Clash with a strong skill and also deal attack damage. Status damage alone cannot prevent the healing condition.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Even after lowering Instincts, blindly hitting a Counter with a strong attack is dangerous. Check every enemy's Instincts and readied skills, then Stagger and defeat weakened enemies.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Everything There of an Inquisitor starts with 4 Instincts; Proceeding Inquisitor starts with 2. At Turn Start, gain Attack Power Up and Protection equal to the value. Taking at least 1 attack damage reduces it by 1; a turn with no attack damage adds 1 at Turn End.

mechanics.0.response.text: This works opposite to the beast type whose Instincts increases when attacked. Land attacks across the team to reduce their bonuses.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Copies the Power, Coin Power, and Coin count of the attack received. Uses Lust, Slash, and the enemy's own level without copying the original skill's On Use or On Hit effects. An ordinary Counter that cannot be Offset.

mechanics.1.response.text: Land a fast Sinner's weak skill first. Being hit as an additional target of a multi-target attack also triggers the Counter, so check targets.

warnings.0.text: A strong first hit is copied. Hitting it with a multi-target E.G.O also triggers the Counter.

warnings.1.text: Ordinary Counters cannot be Offset with defense. Do not apply the procedure used to Offset Evade.

warnings.2.text: Reducing Instincts requires at least 1 attack damage. Burn, Bleed, or other status damage alone is insufficient.

warnings.3.text: Attacks continue after Part destruction. Do not assume breaking a Part stops every action.

warnings.4.text: Do not apply the Refraction Railway version's fixed slot count to this Sacristy encounter.

preparation.0.text: Deploy 5 Sinners against Lv. 26 enemies. Initial Instincts bonuses are active, so use current Clash predictions to prepare skills that beat Adjust Shell.

preparation.1.text: Distinguish skills that can deal at least 1 damage from weak skills intended to trigger the Counter first. Blunt, Wrath, and Envy are effective.

preparation.2.text: Check Counter targets before using multi-target E.G.O. Do not hit every enemy with a high-Power skill unconditionally.

roles.0.reason.text: Keep the copied skill's Power low.

roles.1.reason.text: Reduce Instincts and Protection, and prevent healing from taking no attack damage.

roles.2.reason.text: Prevent healing and renewed Instincts before the hit lands.
